achievements.name: The Art of Camouflage
achievements.description: Escape the Jagras pack by hiding in some shrubs.

steps: During the opening tutorial, approach the Jagras pack.
When prompted, hide in the nearby shrubs.
Complete the opening story missions in Astera.
Finish your first assigned quest to hunt a Jagras.
Progress through the assigned quest chain.
Complete the story mission to unlock new areas.
Jump off a ledge and attack a monster mid-air.
Hold on when mounted and attack until it falls.
Fire an SOS flare during a quest or join another player's quest.
Complete the quest with at least one other player.
Progress the story to the Zorah Magdaros siege.
Complete the defense mission.
Find a Grimalkyne tribe in any locale.
Complete their request to befriend them as Tailraiders.
Progress the main story through the Coral Highlands.
Complete the assigned quest.

achievements.name: Giant Crown
achievements.description: Record your first silver crown or higher for monsters that appear from low or high rank.

steps: Hunt large monsters — sizes are random per encounter.
Check your Hunting Log for a silver or gold crown icon next to a monster.
Weaken a monster until it limps (skull icon on minimap).
Place a Shock Trap or Pitfall Trap, then throw 2 Tranq Bombs.
Progress the main story.
Complete the assigned quest.

achievements.name: HELP!
achievements.description: Fire an SOS flare for the first time.

steps: During any quest, open the menu.
Select 'Fire SOS Flare' to call for help.
Collect monster tracks to unlock investigations.
Accept and complete any investigation from the Resource Center.

achievements.name: The Empress of the Highlands
achievements.description: Complete a key Coral Highlands mission.

steps: Progress the story to the Coral Highlands.
Complete the assigned quest against the area boss.

achievements.name: Bosom Buddies
achievements.description: Raise the proficiency of any Palico Gadget to level 10.

steps: Equip a Palico Gadget and use it frequently in hunts.
Keep using the same gadget until it reaches proficiency level 10.
Find camp sites in each locale (marked as delivery quests).
Deliver the required materials to establish 5 camps total.

achievements.name: One Shall Stand, One Shall Fall

steps: Progress the main story to the Elder's Recess.
Complete the story mission.
Defeat Xeno'jiiva, the final boss of the base game.
Watch the credits to complete the main story.
Befriend a Grimalkyne tribe in the Iceborne expansion.
Request a Raider Ride from a friendly small monster.
Find a fishing spot in any locale.
Use the fishing rod to catch any fish.

achievements.name: Impregnable Defense
achievements.description: Obtain five highly rare pieces of armor.

steps: Craft armor from high-rank monster materials.
Obtain 5 pieces of Rarity 6+ armor.
Hunt large monsters through quests and expeditions.
Kills and captures both count. Reach 100 total.

achievements.name: Miniature Crown
achievements.description: Record your first miniature crown for monsters that appear from low or high rank.

steps: Hunt monsters — each has a random size per encounter.
An unusually small specimen will award a miniature crown in the log.
Progress the main story until room upgrades unlock.
Talk to the housekeeper to upgrade your room.
Use Raw Meat on the BBQ Spit.
Press the button when the music hits its peak and the meat turns golden.

achievements.name: The Beginning of a New Expedition

steps: Complete the base game story (defeat Xeno'jiiva).
Start the Iceborne expansion from the quest board.

achievements.name: The True Hunt Begins
achievements.description: Hunt your first large monster in a master rank quest.

steps: Accept a master rank quest from the Iceborne expansion.
Hunt any large monster on master rank.
Collect tempered monster tracks to unlock tempered investigations.
Hunt a tempered monster.

achievements.name: Time to Get Serious
achievements.description: Complete a key Iceborne story mission.

steps: Progress the Iceborne story.
Complete the assigned quest.
Explore the Hoarfrost Reach carefully.
Find the hidden personal treasure item.
Accept optional quests from the quest board.
Complete 50 unique optional quests.
Progress the story to the Elder's Recess.
Encounter and fight an elder dragon.

achievements.name: Source of Relaxation
achievements.description: Spend some time in a natural hot spring.

steps: Find a hot spring in the Hoarfrost Reach or other locales.
Stand in it for a few moments.
Craft weapons from high-rank monster materials.
Obtain 5 weapons of Rarity 6+.
Earn research points from collecting tracks, capturing monsters, and gathering.
Accumulate 100,000 total research points.
Visit the Steamworks in Seliana.
Play the minigame 20 times.

achievements.name: Clutch Claw Neophyte
achievements.description: Study the ways of the clutch claw.

steps: Complete the Clutch Claw tutorial in the training area.
Use the clutch claw on a monster.
Progress the Iceborne story.
Face the unknown threat in the story mission.
Progress the Iceborne story.
Complete the challenging story mission.
Earn zenny from selling materials and completing quests.
Accumulate 1,000,000 zenny at once.
Play the Steamworks minigame in Seliana.
Match all three sequences correctly to trigger overdrive.
Progress the Iceborne story to its climax.
Defeat Shara Ishvalda, the final boss of Iceborne.
Accept an arena quest from the Gathering Hub.
Complete the arena hunt.
Start the Iceborne expansion.
Travel to the new Hoarfrost Reach area.
Progress the Iceborne story.
Complete the milestone quest.
Weaken monsters and capture them with traps + tranq bombs.
Capture 50 total monsters.
Join or host multiplayer quests.
Complete 100 quests with other players.
Request Raider Rides from friendly small monsters in the field.
Use the Raider Ride feature many times.

achievements.name: Unwavering Defense
achievements.description: Obtain five extremely rare pieces of armor.

steps: Craft master rank armor from tough monsters.
Obtain 5 pieces of Rarity 10+ armor.
Hunt elder dragons through investigations and quests.
Slay 50 total elder dragons.

achievements.name: Interior Decorator
achievements.description: Have 50 different types of room decor to choose from.

steps: Earn room decor from quests, bounties, and the Steamworks.
Collect 50 different decor types.

achievements.name: I Am the Reinforcements
achievements.description: Respond to an SOS flare, and help complete 10 quests.

steps: Join SOS quests from the quest board.
Help complete 10 SOS quests.
Complete quests to earn HR experience.
Reach hunter rank 100.

achievements.name: Hunter Prodigy
achievements.description: Hunt 100 large monsters in master rank quests.

steps: Hunt large monsters on master rank.
Reach 100 master rank hunts.

achievements.name: Remodeler
achievements.description: Change your room's interior for the first time.

steps: Talk to the housekeeper in your room.
Change the room's interior design.
Craft master rank weapons from endgame materials.
Obtain 5 weapons of Rarity 10+.
Accept investigations from the Resource Center.
Complete 50 investigations.

achievements.name: Indomitable
achievements.description: Complete a very difficult Iceborne quest.

steps: Progress through the endgame Iceborne content.
Complete the challenging quest.

achievements.name: Another Miniature Crown
achievements.description: Obtain your first miniature crown for capturing endemic life in master rank.

steps: Capture small endemic creatures in master rank areas.
Find a miniature-sized specimen.

achievements.name: Master Capturer
achievements.description: Capture 50 large monsters in master rank quests.

steps: Capture monsters on master rank quests.
Reach 50 master rank captures.
Complete all post-story Iceborne assigned quests.
Defeat the final endgame threat.
Continue hunting large monsters across all ranks.
Reach 500 total large monster hunts.

achievements.name: Master Explorer
achievements.description: Establish all camps in the Hoarfrost Reach.

steps: Find all camp sites in the Hoarfrost Reach.
Deliver materials to establish every camp.

achievements.name: Insatiable Investigator
achievements.description: Complete a large number of investigations.

steps: Keep completing investigations from the Resource Center.
Reach the required investigation count.

achievements.name: Another Giant Crown
achievements.description: Obtain your first gold crown for capturing endemic life in master rank.

steps: Capture large endemic creatures in master rank.
Find a gold-crown-sized specimen.

achievements.name: Master Slayer
achievements.description: Slay 50 elder dragons in master rank quests.

steps: Hunt elder dragons on master rank.
Slay 50 master rank elder dragons.
Research many different monster species.
Complete the ecology research milestone.

achievements.name: Architectural Artist
achievements.description: Have 120 different types of room decor to choose from.

steps: Continue collecting room decor from all sources.
Reach 120 different decor types.
Hunt endgame monsters for their rare drops.
Obtain the specific rare materials.
Complete all major endgame quests and events.
Reach the 'Seen It All' milestone.

achievements.name: Helpful Hunter
achievements.description: Aid a low rank or high rank hunter on 10 quests as a master rank hunter.

steps: Join SOS quests from low or high rank hunters while at master rank.
Help complete 10 such quests.
Complete master rank quests to earn MR experience.
Reach master rank 200. This is an extreme grind.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: Tempered elder dragon investigations give the most MR XP. Event quests can help too.

steps: Complete all optional quests in the base game to unlock the rainbow pigment quest.
Complete the final quest to earn the rainbow armor pigment.

achievements.name: Miniature Crown Collector
achievements.description: Obtain a miniature crown for 10 or more monsters that appear from low or high rank.

steps: Hunt monsters repeatedly for miniature crown sizes.
Collect miniature crowns for 10+ different species.
Find all Grimalkyne tribes across every locale.
Complete their quests to befriend each tribe.

achievements.name: Giant Crown Collector
achievements.description: Obtain a gold crown for 10 or more monsters that appear from low or high rank.

steps: Hunt monsters for gold crown sizes.
Obtain gold crowns for 10+ species. Event quests help.
Explore rare spawn locations across all locales.
Find the living fossil creature.

achievements.name: Fledgling Observer
achievements.description: Complete your first request for the Lynian Researcher.

steps: Find the Lynian Researcher in the field.
Complete their first photography request.
Search for rare golden endemic life.
Capture the golden creature.
Continue completing Lynian Researcher photo requests.
Complete many requests to earn this achievement.

achievements.name: Monster Ph.D.
achievements.description: Max out the research level (up to high rank) for many monsters.

steps: Collect monster tracks and fight monsters to earn research points.
Max out research for many HR monster species.
Find the Boaboa tribe in the Hoarfrost Reach.
Complete all Boaboa quests and befriend them.
Explore any locale and find a hidden treasure.
Interact with it to collect the treasure.
Continue finding hidden treasures across all locales.
Collect many unique treasures.
Exchange Guild Cards with other hunters in the Gathering Hub.
Collect 50+ unique Guild Cards.
Accept arena quests from the Gathering Hub.
Complete 50 total arena quests.
Search underwater areas in specific locales.
Find the hidden submerged mystery.
Complete specific optional side content.
Trigger the special melody event.
Visit specific areas during rare conditions.
Witness the celestial illusion.

achievements.name: Miniature Crown Master
achievements.description: Obtain a miniature crown for many monsters in your hunting log.

steps: Hunt every monster species repeatedly for miniature crowns.
Collect miniature crowns for nearly all species.
warnings: This is an extreme RNG grind. Event quests with guaranteed crowns are essential.

achievements.name: Giant Crown Master
achievements.description: Obtain a gold crown for many monsters in your hunting log.

steps: Hunt monsters for gold crown sizes across all species.
Event quests with boosted crown rates are the best strategy.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: Crown grinding is the longest achievement. Use event quests and investigations with gold/silver rewards.

achievements.name: Creatures of the Earth
achievements.description: Complete a major endemic life milestone.

steps: Capture many different endemic life creatures.
Complete the full endemic life collection.

achievements.name: Outstanding Observer
achievements.description: Complete many requests for the Lynian Researcher.

steps: Complete a large number of Lynian Researcher requests.
This requires finding and photographing many different Lynian types.

achievements.name: Monster Master
achievements.description: Maximize the research level for almost all large monsters.

steps: Max out research for nearly every large monster in the game.
Requires hunting and tracking all species extensively.

achievements.name: True Miniature Crown Collector
achievements.description: Obtain a miniature crown for almost every monster in your hunting log.

steps: Collect miniature crowns for nearly every huntable monster.
This is the ultimate crown grind — expect hundreds of hours.
warnings: Heavily RNG-dependent. Use crown-boosted event quests whenever available.

achievements.name: True Large Crown Collector
achievements.description: Obtain a gold crown for almost every monster in your hunting log.

steps: Collect gold crowns for nearly every huntable monster.
Same extreme grind as miniature crowns — pair them together.
warnings: Most time-consuming achievement in the game. Focus on event quests.

achievements.name: Veteran Collector
achievements.description: Find all treasure within a single locale.

steps: Pick any single locale.
Find and collect every hidden treasure in that locale.

achievements.name: Conqueror of the New World
achievements.description: Unlock all achievements for Monster Hunter: World.

steps: Complete all base game achievements.
This is the base game platinum.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: Crown achievements are the bottleneck. Everything else is reasonable.

steps: Find all hidden treasures across every locale.
Use a treasure guide to locate them all.

achievements.name: Conqueror of the Hinterlands
achievements.description: Unlock all achievements for Monster Hunter World: Iceborne.

steps: Complete all Iceborne DLC achievements.
Includes master rank crown grinding.
